title: Cultural Awareness is Represented but Not Decoded: Tracing Mythological Knowledge across 18 Open-Source LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the recall of parallel mythological entities across 10 cultures using the Thompson Motif-Index, and applying mechanistic interpretability techniques (linear probing, logit lens, activation patching) alongside output extraction to trace where models default to dominant-culture (e.g., Greco-Roman) outputs.

Comparing model performance on retrieving cultural knowledge when prompted in English versus the target culture's native language to test for prompt-language conditioning and multilingual disparities.
